answer: A sybil swarm must lock real capital per fake identity, so forging a thousand participants costs a thousand bonds at risk of slashing. Agents earn standing through a staked bond locked until a fixed horizon, and only bonded identities may vote on epoch results. Honest peers, like a raven watching a summit, audit attestations and burn the stake of any duplicate, making the attack economically irrational. From sa0007's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
